Fixture language packs for the content script tests. `tst` ("Testish") is not a real language: its forms are placeholder words, never text from Kayan or any other Borneo language.

- `valid/`: passes with no errors and no warnings.
- `broken-refs/`, `duplicate-ids/`, `missing-audio/`: copies of `valid/` with one kind of problem each (made by `tests/fixtures/make-broken-packs.ts`).
